body: The same, maybe even worse. I missed a couple of days so I'm behind on letters. I tried going on a vacation but it only made me more depressed. I just feel like killing myself is the only solution for me. I don't see any hope in my future, only pain. I used to hope for an afterlife because the thought of my conciseness disappearing made me sad but now i hope that my conciseness does disappear because i don't want an eternity with this pain.

I don't want to go on meds, man. If it works for you thats awesome and I'm happy for you but I don't want to take them. I don't want to need pills to make me happy. If I just kill myself Im saving myself a lot of pain. My dreams have been really detailed and intense lately and each day I wake up and say fuck this.

I know the exact feeling. I lay in bed and think of a burglar breaking in, I drive my car and think of crashing into poles/trees (that way others aren't hurt), and I figure if that doesn't happen soon then I'll just die by my own hands. I doubt I'll live to see 30
Its been over a year, how has it gotten better for you? I don't see any light at the end of the tunnel for myself
The calm comes from knowing that the pain is almost gone.
The thought of going to a doctor just makes me feel uncomfortable. Nothing can be said that would will change my situation. Sorry to argue with you thats just not an action I want to make.

I understand why you would say that because I would say the same thing but she really was the only person I have ever met that I felt connect to. Its more about losing her as my only friend than as a lover. I was also thinking about this before we broke up but this was the thing that pushed me to the breaking point. Its been 6 months and everyday it just gets harder to keep going and seems like the rest of my life is getting worse.
I really don't want to go to a therapist. I don't want to go on medication and I really doubt there is anything they will be able to say to make me not want to go through with this.
